prompt_text: A surreal, clean, high-contrast chess environment. The ground is a giant black-and-white chessboard under a flat gray sky. Oversized glossy black and white chess pieces surround the board. A large reflective chrome sphere stands near the center as a key landmark. A gray humanoid mannequin is standing in the chessboard scene and is the player character. Bright overhead lighting. The character is the gray humanoid mannequin.
